summary.request: Routing operations get a Coating Spec code. It must appear on production order routing lines, whether the order is created and refreshed by hand or created from the planning worksheet, and on the subcontracting purchase order line created for that operation.
summary.business-process: Manufacturing: routings, production order creation (refresh and planning carry-out), production order status changes and subcontracting purchasing

objects.purpose: Master value: the Coating Spec code the user enters per routing operation. Source for both the refresh path and the planning path.

objects.purpose: Holds the value on production order routing lines. Filled before insert on refresh and on carry-out; survives status changes (Planned/Firm Planned -> Released -> Finished) by record assignment, so no status-change code is needed. A refresh that recalculates routings deletes and rebuilds these lines, so a per-order manual change is reset to the routing value (see q-per-order-edit).

objects.purpose: Event subscribers that copy Coating Spec on the refresh path, the planning path, carry-out, and the subcontracting make-order step.

objects.target: Routing lines subpage (page that lists Routing Line on the Routing card)
objects.purpose: Lets users enter Coating Spec per operation. Tooltip on the table field (runtime 13.0+) or on the page control for earlier targets.

objects.target: Prod. Order Routing (page listing Prod. Order Routing Line)
objects.purpose: Shows Coating Spec on production order routing lines, as the request requires.
Shows Coating Spec on the subcontracting purchase order line.

data-flow.note: Entered per operation on the routing.

data-flow.to: Prod. Order Routing Line (refresh: Refresh Production Order -> Calculate Prod. Order -> CopyFromRoutingLine)
data-flow.note: OnAfterCopyFromRoutingLine runs before insert; no Modify. Covers orders created by hand and refreshed.

data-flow.to: Planning Routing Line (Mfg. Planning Line Management -> TransferFromRoutingLine)
Prod. Order Routing Line (Mfg. Carry Out Action.TransferRouting -> CopyFromPlanningRoutingLine)
data-flow.note: OnAfterCopyFromPlanningRoutingLine; this path never reads Routing Line.

data-flow.to: Prod. Order Routing Line (new status: Released, Finished)
data-flow.note: Prod. Order Status Management copies the whole record by assignment, including extension fields; no subscriber.

data-flow.from: Prod. Order Routing Line (Released), read via Requisition Line keys
data-flow.note: OnInsertPurchOrderLineOnAfterTransferFromReqLineToPurchLine, before insert. Every subcontracting path (base Calculate Subcontracts, Subc. Calculate Subcontracts, Subcontracting app direct creation) meets here.
Archiving copies lines by field number.

subscriptions.purpose: Refresh path: ProdOrderRoutingLine."Coating Spec" := RoutingLine."Coating Spec".
guards: Assign only; runs before insert, so no Modify.

subscriptions.purpose: Planning path: PlanningRoutingLine."Coating Spec" := RoutingLine."Coating Spec".
guards: Assign only; runs before insert, so no Modify.

subscriptions.purpose: Carry-out path: ProdOrderRoutingLine."Coating Spec" := PlanningRoutingLine."Coating Spec".
guards: Copy from the Planning Routing Line, not by looking up the master Routing Line.
Assign only; runs before insert, so no Modify.

subscriptions.purpose: Set PurchOrderLine."Coating Spec" from the released Prod. Order Routing Line before the purchase line is inserted.
guards: Exit unless RequisitionLine."Prod. Order No." and "Operation No." are filled (ordinary purchase lines use the same code) - cheap in-memory check before any database call.
Get(Status::Released, "Prod. Order No.", "Routing Reference No.", "Routing No.", "Operation No.") with SetLoadFields("Coating Spec"); only assign when found.
Do not use the obsolete Calculate Subcontracts report events and do not patch purchase lines after carry-out.

lifecycle.step: Set DataClassification on every Coating Spec table field (all nine table extensions) to a real classification - the manufacturing samples use CustomerContent - never ToBeClassified. Classification lives on the table fields, not on the page extensions.

Tooltip: on runtime 13.0 (BC24) or later, define one ToolTip on the table field and let the bound page fields inherit it; for earlier targets add a page-level ToolTip on each page extension control. Text should say what the coating spec is used for, without inventing behavior.
No new table or exposed object is designed, so no new permission set entry is required unless q-coating-spec-master adds a Coating Spec master table (then design its permissions with that entity).

tests.given: An item with a routing whose operation has a random Coating Spec (fixtures built with the manufacturing/inventory Library codeunits, full chain: item, work center, routing certified, assigned to item)
tests.when: A released production order is created for the item and refreshed with routings calculated
tests.then: The Prod. Order Routing Line for that operation has the routing line's Coating Spec

tests.given: An item with demand, a certified routing whose operation has a Coating Spec, and a planning worksheet
tests.then: The Planning Routing Line for that operation carries the Coating Spec

tests.given: A planning line with Planning Routing Lines holding a Coating Spec (the value on the Planning Routing Line is changed so it differs from the master Routing Line)
tests.when: Carry Out Action Message creates a production order
tests.then: The Prod. Order Routing Line has the Planning Routing Line value, not the master routing value

tests.given: A firm planned production order whose routing line has a Coating Spec
tests.when: The order is changed to Released
tests.then: The released Prod. Order Routing Line has the same Coating Spec, with no custom status-change code

tests.given: A released production order whose routing line Coating Spec was changed by hand
tests.when: The order is refreshed with routings recalculated
tests.then: The value is back to the master routing value (documents the behaviour for q-per-order-edit)

tests.given: A released production order whose operation runs on a work center with a subcontractor vendor and has a Coating Spec, plus the full vendor and posting setup
tests.when: Calculate Subcontracts runs and the subcontracting worksheet is carried out
tests.then: The created Purchase Line for that operation has the routing line's Coating Spec

tests.given: The Microsoft Subcontracting app installed and a released order routing line with a Coating Spec on a subcontracting work center
tests.when: A subcontracting purchase order is created directly from the routing line
tests.then: The Purchase Line has the Coating Spec (only if the app is in scope; see q-subcontracting-app)

tests.given: A requisition line for an item with no Prod. Order No. or Operation No.
tests.when: The requisition worksheet is carried out
tests.then: The Purchase Line Coating Spec is blank and no error is raised (guard exits)

tests.given: A subcontracting purchase order line with a Coating Spec and the full posting-group chain
tests.when: The purchase order is posted (receive and invoice)
tests.then: Purch. Rcpt. Line and Purch. Inv. Line carry the Coating Spec

tests.given: A subcontracting purchase order line with a Coating Spec
tests.then: Purchase Line Archive carries the Coating Spec

knowledge.used-for: Core mechanism: fields on Routing Line, Planning Routing Line and Prod. Order Routing Line, and the three copy subscriptions for refresh, planning and carry-out.
constraints: Add the field to Routing Line, Planning Routing Line and Prod. Order Routing Line.

Subscribe to OnAfterCopyFromRoutingLine and OnAfterCopyFromPlanningRoutingLine on Prod. Order Routing Line and OnAfterTransferFromRoutingLine on Planning Routing Line; all run before insert, so no Modify.
Do not rely only on Calculate Prod. Order OnAfterTransferRoutingLine: orders from the planning worksheet would have an empty field.
Do not fill the field in OnAfterInsertEvent by looking up Routing Line: extra Modify per operation and the wrong source for planned orders.
A refresh that recalculates routings deletes and rebuilds routing lines; a value typed per order is reset. State in the design whether per-order changes are allowed.

knowledge.used-for: Subcontracting purchase line: where every creation path meets and how to read the routing line.
constraints: Copy at the make-order step: subscribe to OnInsertPurchOrderLineOnAfterTransferFromReqLineToPurchLine on Req. Wksh.-Make Order.
Exit unless RequisitionLine "Prod. Order No." and "Operation No." are filled.
Read the routing line with Get(Status::Released, Prod. Order No., Routing Reference No., Routing No., Operation No.) and set the purchase line field before insert.
Do not depend on the obsolete Calculate Subcontracts report events (obsolete pending, tag 28.0; events obsolete for 29.0); the Subcontracting app direct path never passes through it.
Add the field to Requisition Line only if planners must see it, and the direct path does not fill it.
Do not patch purchase lines after Carry Out Action.

knowledge.used-for: Status changes of the production order carry the routing line field; no subscriber needed.
constraints: Add the field once on the production order table and rely on the status change record assignment to carry it.
Use the OnCopyFrom... events only to change a value on the way.
Do not re-copy in OnAfterTransProdOrder with Modify.

knowledge.used-for: Posted purchase line and archive targets of the Purchase Line field.
constraints: Give the field the same number, name, type and length on Purchase Line and on every TransferFields target the plan needs; unless the plan states a document type never needs it, that means all four posted tables and the archive.
No subscriber is needed for these stages.
Keep the mirrored fields non-editable on the posted tables.

knowledge.used-for: Type and length agreement for every mirrored Coating Spec field.
constraints: Define mirrored fields with the exact same field number, data type and length on every table in the cascade at creation time.

knowledge.used-for: Field length if Coating Spec gets a TableRelation to a master table (depends on q-coating-spec-master).
constraints: For an unconditional relation, give the field the same type and exact length as the related field; read the related field's declared length rather than assuming Code[20].
Open the subscriber with a cheap in-memory predicate before any database call.
Use SetLoadFields for the columns the body reads.

knowledge.used-for: Data classification of the new fields.
constraints: Do not ship ToBeClassified; resolve to a real classification decided from the data's content.
DataClassification belongs on the table fields, not on page fields.

knowledge.used-for: Tooltips for the page extension controls.
constraints: User-facing page fields need an explicit or inherited ToolTip; on runtime 13.0+ define it on the table field and omit duplicates; earlier targets need page-level tooltips.
Tooltip text should say what the value is used for and must not invent behaviour.

knowledge.used-for: Tooltip inheritance on bound page fields; applies from BC24 (bc-version unknown).
constraints: On runtime 13.0 or later a bound page field inherits the table field ToolTip; do not add a duplicate page-level property.
Exactly one WHEN per test; precondition actions (refresh, release, posting) go in GIVEN unless they are the action under test.
Build items, routings, work centers, vendors and orders with the Library codeunits, parents first, validating foreign keys; no hand-rolled Init/Insert.

knowledge.used-for: Test preconditions for subcontracting and posting tests.
constraints: GIVEN must set up every precondition the process reads, e.g. the full posting-group chain for posting tests and the subcontracting work center and vendor for subcontracting tests.

open-questions.question: Is Coating Spec a free code, or must it be validated against a master list (a new Coating Spec table or an existing table)? If a master table is needed, its key length sets the field length and it needs its own table, pages and permissions.
May users change the Coating Spec on a production order routing line? If yes, they must accept that a refresh that recalculates routings resets it to the routing value.

Must the Coating Spec also reach posted receipt, invoice, credit memo and return shipment lines and archived purchase lines? The design includes them because the mirroring guidance requires every TransferFields target unless you exclude a document type.

Must planners see the Coating Spec on the subcontracting worksheet (Requisition Line)? It is not designed; if needed it is filled from OnAfterTransferProdOrderRoutingLine of the report your version uses and is not filled by the Subcontracting app's direct creation path.
Which BC version is targeted, and is the Microsoft Subcontracting app in use? This decides which subcontracting creation paths the tests must cover.
Must the Coating Spec appear anywhere else, such as the Planning Routing page, the purchase order printout, or the vendor's subcontracting documents?
Must existing routings, open production orders or open subcontracting purchase lines be back-filled, or does the value apply only to new orders?
